diff --git a/src/Makefile b/src/Makefile
index 5cb4f673b..4bb4433ec 100644
--- a/src/Makefile
+++ b/src/Makefile
@@ -89,6 +89,14 @@ ifneq (,$(filter aarch64 armv%,$(uname_M)))
         CFLAGS+=-funwind-tables
 endif
 
+# RISC-V: use the mtime CSR (csrr time) for monotonic clock reads instead of the
+# clock_gettime syscall. The RISC-V fast path in monotonic.c is gated behind
+# USE_PROCESSOR_CLOCK; enabling it only for RISC-V keeps the x86 TSC path and
+# the aarch64 CNTVCT path behavior unchanged.
+ifneq (,$(findstring riscv,$(uname_M)))
+        REDIS_CFLAGS+=-DUSE_PROCESSOR_CLOCK
+endif
+
 # Backwards compatibility for selecting an allocator
 ifeq ($(USE_TCMALLOC),yes)
 	MALLOC=tcmalloc
